name: Chargebacks911 Prevent for WooCommerce
author: chargebacks911

sections.description:
Chargebacks911 Prevent helps protect your business by notifying you when a customer disputes a payment, giving you a chance to take action before it becomes a chargeback.

Simply connect your store, set up your payment information, and choose the protection services that work for you. Receive early alerts, manage disputes in one place, and let automated tools handle eligible disputes.

How Chargebacks911 Prevent helps your business

  • Get early alerts: Know when a customer disputes a payment through Ethoca and Verifi.
  • Take action sooner: Review alerts and respond before they turn into costly chargebacks.
  • Automate dispute resolution: Use Rapid Dispute Resolution (RDR) to automatically resolve eligible disputes.
  • Manage everything in one place: View alerts, track activity, and receive email notifications.
  • Pay as you go: No upfront payment. Pay only when you receive a dispute notification or resolution.

Less time managing disputes. Fewer chargebacks. More revenue protected.
